Injury Shuts Down Arrieche for Season
Obviously disappointed, <Gregori Arrieche:player#139638> confirmed today that his season is officially over. The <Everett:team#278> reliever offered mostly monosyllabic responses to reporters. "Nope," he said, when asked if he might possibly return this year. The 24-year-old Arrieche suffered a torn ulnar collateral ligament on 05/09/2026 and has been out of action since.

This year, <Arrieche:player#139638> has 4 relief appearances with 1 save, 0-1 season record and a 8.10 ERA. He has hurled 13.1 innings, given up 16 hits, struck out 10 and walked 5. Opposing clubs have batted .302 against the <Everett:team#278> reliever.
